name: needed-utility
summary: Offline-first multi-tool toolbox with 10 tools (converter, calculator, tip & split, discount, notes, stopwatch & timer with vibration+notification, flashlight, QR scanner, QR generator, randomizer incl. password generator) on an extensible grouped home screen. Material 3 + Material You, AGP 9 built-in Kotlin. Build clean with zero warnings; smoke-tested on a physical device.
nextSteps: Password manager tool (deferred; generator already in Randomizer)
More tools: QR history, note search/tags
Release signing config + first signed build
Extract shared composables as tool count grows
